summary: Builtin Array keys iterator observes length changes until it becomes done.

semantics.growth: new indices can be yielded before completion
semantics.shrink: indices at or beyond new length stop iteration

tests.name: growth
tests.input: const a=[1]; const it=a.keys(); console.log(it.next().value); a.push(2); console.log(it.next().value);

tests.name: shrink
tests.input: const a=[1,2]; const it=a.keys(); console.log(it.next().value); a.length=1; console.log(it.next().done);
